verdict.rationale: Jeeves hosts an llms.txt at https://tryjeeves.com/llms.txt, and multiple documentation snippets (jeeves-docs-4,5,6,7,49) are explicitly sourced from that file, confirming it exists and contains structured, agent-readable product/API summaries. A probe against a different domain (redocly.app/llms.txt) 404s, but that is not the canonical llms.txt path and doesn't contradict the working one at tryjeeves.com. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can successfully fetch and parse the file end-to-end, and clarity on why two different domains have inconsistent llms.txt availability.
